method.method_draft: First describe the image: X is drawn as the largest atom, Y smaller, and Z the smallest. Use the text statement that X, Y, and Z are from the same period. Since atomic size decreases left to right across a period, infer the order across the period is X, then Y, then Z. Since electronegativity increases left to right across a period, conclude that element Z must have the greatest electronegativity.

Use the text statement that all three elements are in the same period, so shielding and valence shell level are comparable. A smaller radius in the same period means the nucleus attracts electrons more strongly.
